column1: # verify/attribution/classes.tsv -- the residual attribution rules.
# Grammar (tab or | separated):  range | writer-regex | class | row-or-DP | kind | legs
#   range        0xLO-0xHI (HI exclusive), 0xADDR (one word), SPAD:0xLO-0xHI (scratchpad guest addresses)
#   writer-regex applied to the writer named by a --watch watch.log line for the word ("" = any / no census needed)
#   class        the class id (one token)
#   row-or-DP    the EQUIVALENCE_PLAN §7.1 row id, or DP-<n>, or OPEN-<name>; a ROW/DP rule wider than 64 words
#                must carry `recorded:<record>` naming the record that names the WHOLE range (else it is demoted
#                to MIXED by attribute_probe.py -- a region rule without a recorded word is never ROW); a ROW rule
#                may carry `proof=console:<raw EE image>@<leg>:b<N>` (DT-7: the console image matched to that probe
#                pair; a word books as `booked_console` on that pair only where console == NEW != OLD, word by word)
#   kind         ROW (OLD-defect row, attributed) | DP (decided, no row yet) | OPEN (an OPEN decision) |
#                MIXED (region named; several classes incl. OPEN ones write it -- NOT 100 % attributed)
#   legs         * or a comma list of leg names (coldboot, artdet_f37152, ...)
# Directives: `@heap <addr>` / `@pool <addr>` / `@pool-used <addr>` = the title's heap header, record-pool header and
#   the pool's live-record counter (relocate_compare.py's walk asserts used == counter on both images);
#   `@reloc-class <reloc class> <ledger class> <row-or-DP> <kind> [legs]` books ONE relocation class to a row/DP -- without a
#   directive every relocation class is kind OPEN (`OPEN-RELOC-<class>`); the tool never books a class to a row itself; the
#   optional `legs` token (`*` or a comma list) scopes the booking to the legs whose evidence proved it (P8.26-B).
@heap 0x31afb8
@pool 0x31b138
@pool-used 0x323278
# The PAGE POOL (slab allocator; P8.13-B): header at 0x31aff8 (+4 descriptors 0xb84be0, +8 class table 0xf58560, +0xc pages
# 0xb8c560, 972 x 4 KB; +0x1c/+0x24 the free-page stack; +0x30.. 63 class-list heads up to 0x31b124), walked by slab_walk.py.
@slabpool 0x31aff8 63
# The scratchpad is the main thread's stack: the crt0 (0x100068-0x100094) fills all 16 KB with 0xa1b2c3d4 before setting
# $sp = 0x70004000; spad_stack.py reads every thread's saved $sp from THRD on both images (anchors: the boundary thread's
# 0x70004220 -> offset 0x220 under the 14-bit SPR mirror; live frames [0x220, 0x270) = the FUN_001a0150/FUN_0019fd58/
# FUN_0017d558 chain). The stack grows DOWN through the mirror: a callee pushing more than 0x220 bytes wraps to the top of
# the scratchpad (0x70004220 - 0x258 = 0x70003fc8), so the differing words at 0x2b20-0x3ff8 are stale callee frames BELOW
# the live $sp (P8.13-B review MAJOR 1; P8.14-B), not boot residue.
@spad-fill 0xa1b2c3d4
# The title's code (frame-shape evidence: code addresses in the dead words) -- the ELF's .text proper
# (0x100000-0x2d9a08; .vutext/.data/.vudata/.rodata/.sdata follow to 0x30a0b8 and hold DATA pointers, not code).
@spad-text 0x100000-0x2d9a08
# The scratchpad is DUAL-USE (P8.14-B, the recomp read): FUN_002ae318 is a SPAD-stack CONTEXT SWITCH (memcpy 0x70000000 ->
# save+0x1f0 x 0x4000, $sp saved at +0x41f4 and relocated into the copy by `daddu sp,v1`, callback, memcpy back, $sp restored:
# 0x2ae400-0x2ae488 and 0x2aea7c-0x2aeaf4) -- while active the live $sp is in RAM (condition C1); FUN_002b6fd8 (the MPEG
# decoder's context init, called by sceMpegCreate-like FUN_002b70a8 at 0x2b7214) installs the scratchpad as the decoder's
# (ctx+0x87c == 1 -> RAM buffers at ctx+0x880/+0xb80/+0xe80 uncached); the IPU DMA (_ch3dmaCSC FUN_002b9268: 0x700003ff ->
# IPU_CMD, 0x70000000 -> ch MADR) streams through them while a picture decodes. Condition C3 (no decode in flight): IPU DMA
# ch3/ch4 CHCR.STR clear on both images AND no saved frame of ANY thread's chain inside the decoder libraries' text, which is
# the WHOLE libmpeg + libipu band of hle/sdk_bindings.tsv: libmpeg.a 0x2b6fd8 (_clearOnce; sceMpegCreate 0x2b70a8,
# sceMpegGetPicture 0x2b7c10, _ch3dmaCSC 0x2b9268, _sceMpegPictureData0 0x2bd378, _slice0 0x2bd5b8, _sceMpegWaitIpuIdle
# 0x2be580, receiveDataFromIPU 0x2bfb98) .. 0x2c0ec0 (_pictureDisplayExtension), then libipu.a 0x2c0fb8 (setD3_CHCR),
# 0x2c10a8 sceIpuStopDMA, 0x2c1190 sceIpuRestartDMA, 0x2c12e0 sceIpuSync, 0x2c13c0 sceIpuInit -- whose body ends at the
# next function 0x2c15f8 (an FPU routine, not libipu; the next bound SDK function is libgraph sceGsResetGraph 0x2c1bd8).
# The decode is synchronous on the calling thread, so a decode interrupted at a boundary leaves that thread's chain in the
# band or the IPU DMA running; the images carry no IPU section (CTRL busy is unsaved on both trees), so the inner context's
# state words (+0x87c mode, +0x0 status, +0x820 the _slice0 bank toggle, +0x848/+0x84c slice DMA words) are REPORTED only.
@spad-decoder-text 0x2b6fd8-0x2c15f8
# Structural classes are OPEN until a directive books them. The directives below were BOOKED by P8.19-A (DECISIONS_LOG DT-3 MADE,
# the SESSION-14 row's record-pool scope in EQUIVALENCE_PLAN 7.1); each one cites the proof file that names its class word by word.
# DT-3 (MADE, P8.19-A): NONSTATE is reported as its own column, never excluded from the total and never "attributed"; a window
# with NONSTATE words stays BLOCKED for the re-baseline gate until DR-1's rule is met on the OTHER kinds.
#   proof: int_work/p814b + p815b/p818b ledger JSONs (`spad` block per pair: C1 Y C2 Y C3 Y on all 22 anchor pairs, `thr 2/2;
#   band hits none; dma []/[]; ctx 2/2 eq Y`; coldboot C1 N -> spad-sp-unproved, NOT booked), DECISIONS_LOG LEDGER P8.14-B (1)/(d), P8.15-B.

#   proof: slab_walk.py from both images (free page / free-chunk BODY on both sides by the page pool's own lists; the +0 LINK word
#   is slab-free-link = allocator STATE and stays OPEN), LEDGER P8.14-B (2)/(d): 880 words over the 24 pairs.

#   pool keeps its free link in META, not in the chunk), LEDGER P8.12-B (1), P8.13-B (3): 35,583 words at coldboot b120.
